bifrost: bifrost_app::log (springboard/sdk/src/log.rs re-exporting springboard/core/src/log.rs), bifrost-log CLI (springboard/sdk/src/bin/bifrost-log.rs), Console app (springboard/apps/console-desktop)
summary: The read side (OSLogStore, OSLogEntryLog) and the write side (os.Logger levels, subsystem registry, per-subsystem private and level config) are built, with journald as the store. Entries, activities, signposts, boundaries, enumerator and position tokens, and format payloads are not built; OSSignposter is planned for phase 3 only.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/log.rs (LogStore::current_process, LogStore::local, LogStore::system, LogStore::entries); wired: springboard/apps/console-desktop/src/console.rs (Saved Searches sidebar section, open_saved, keep_search, drop_search); model.rs (SavedSearch, save_search, remove_search)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. current_process reads an in-memory ring of 2000 entries; local() needs kind = "system-app" and the log-store entitlement; no Apple scope enum type Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/log.rs (LogEntry { date, process, pid, subsystem, category, level, message })
features.note: same core fields as OSLogEntryLog; the entry class hierarchy is flattened into one struct

features.apple: Logger, debug, info, notice, error, fault
features.note: levels map to syslog priorities 7, 6, 5, 3, 2; info is written when the level allows it, not kept in memory only

features.apple: OSLogStore.entries(...) polled or streamed in Console and Instruments
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/log.rs (LogStore::stream, blocking, run on a thread); wired: springboard/apps/console-desktop/src/console.rs (drain applies the search to each arriving message)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. journald follow via journalctl for system scope; in-process stream polls the ring every 200 ms Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: NSPredicate over subsystem, category, process, level, composedMessage
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/log.rs (Query, Query::parse_predicate, Query::matches); wired: springboard/core/src/log.rs (Query); springboard/apps/console-desktop/src/model.rs (Query::parse with level: and message: tokens)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. subset: ==, >=, CONTAINS joined by AND; subsystem, category, process, level, message, last, limit Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: Message interpolation with privacy: .public and .private, redacted in logs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. privacy is per subsystem (private = true in the registry), not per value; no per-argument masks

features.apple: Subsystem and category on Logger; per-subsystem log config
features.note: manifests declare subsystems and categories; /etc/bifrost/log.toml overrides levels

Headless tests run journal lines and coredump rows through the buffer, the search tokens and the Info and Debug toggles, and check that a claimed subsystem is not found by a subsystem search. Still needs a live journal on the lab machine to confirm the reader against real entries.

features.apple: Subsystem tied to the writing process (kernel-set identity)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/log.rs (may_log_as, app_of_exe, attributed); springboard/sdk/src/log_ownership.rs (check_claim, owner_of, ClaimError)
features.note: check_claim gives log tools the store app's claim decision from the registry, tested headless: a subsystem belongs to the app that declared it, and the shell subsystem is reserved. Gap: the writer identity is the journal's executable path, checked on read only, and the log store still removes a refused claim itself.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-38, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no activity events in the log model

features.apple: OSLogEntrySignpost, OSSignposter, interval begin and end

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-38, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no partition metadata between entry sequences

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-38, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no lazy enumerator and no position tokens; docs/bifrost-ui.md states this gap

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-38, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no format specifiers or message components; the whole value is marked private or public
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. process name and pid only; no sender image or library metadata

gaps: OSSignposter and signpost entries (phase 3 in docs/milestone-unified-logging.md)
Activity, boundary and payload entry types and OSLogMessageComponent
Lazy OSLogEnumerator and persistent OSLogPosition tokens (LogStore::entries returns a Vec)
Per-argument privacy (.public, .private(mask:)) and format specifiers; privacy is per subsystem only
Info-level entries kept in memory only (Apple keeps info transiently)
Predicate language is a subset (==, >=, CONTAINS, AND only)
Journal reader shells out to journalctl; app access to the journal needs the systemd-journal group (unverified on Midget)
